evidence.quote: the e2e suite asserts that saving a memory enrolls its creator as a reviewer.

observations.why: Plain unhedged assertion of what the suite does — asserted and ready to defend, but no ratification language or performed settling to lift it to decision.

evidence.quote: This probe memory exists only to carry that assertion.

observations.why: Flat declarative stating the purpose of the probe — no hedging, no performed ratification; a committed assertion resting at claim.
